data.name: Sarajit
data.gender_notes: Sarajit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sara means 'rule' and Jit means 'victory'. So, Sarajit means 'one who rules with victory'. This name is perfect for a child who is destined for greatness and is determined to rule his life with courage and strength. The name Sarajit carries the meaning “Victorious, Rule, King” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sarajit usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, rule, king and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sarajit is a spiritual name that symbolizes the inner strength and courage of an individual. It is believed that those named Sarajit possess the power to overcome any obstacle and achieve their goals with determination and perseverance.
data.etymology: Sarajit belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious, Rule, King.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sarajit total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
